data.exact_reserve_text: Included within claims notified of USD 1,398.0m (2021: USD 1,400.1m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of USD 229.9m (2021: increase in claims notified relating to 2020 and prior years of account USD 397.3m which is impacted by effect of RITC noted in the table above ).
data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table, prior-year development (for underwriting years 2020 and earlier) shows a net favourable movement of approximately USD 21.4m (a release). The movement is mixed across individual years (some years show strengthening, others releases). The Syndicate also completed a loss portfolio reinsurance (LPR) on 1 December 2022 which relates predominantly to 2019 and prior years and has impacted reported net claims and reinsurance recoveries. RITC activity in prior periods also affects comparability of development metrics.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within claims notified of USD 1,398.0m (2021: USD 1,400.1m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of USD 229.9m (2021: increase in claims notified relating to 2020 and prior years of account USD 397.3m which is impacted by effect of RITC noted in the table above ).

Effective 1 December 2022, the Syndicate completed a loss portfolio reinsurance contract (LPR) with another Lloyd's syndicate. Under the agreement, the Syndicate has been indemnified against potential adverse development in respect of net liabilities for a premium of USD 59.7m, providing the Syndicate with protection in several professional lines insurance portfolios, predominantly relating to 2019 and prior years of account.
The income statement includes USD 59.7m of reinsurance premium for the LPR and USD 59.7m of reinsurance recoveries in net claims.

With effect from 1 January 2021, the 2018 year of account of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 closed by way of an RITC into the 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1686 thus concluding the business of both Syndicate 6129 and Syndicate 2007. The financial impact of this transaction is nil.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) as the primary source (sum of diagonal changes for underwriting years 2014-2020). The report contains RITC activity (impacting 2019 figures) and an LPR entered 1 Dec 2022 affecting net claims; these transactions can distort comparability. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was provided, so triangle method was used. LOB-level reserve movements are not quantified in the report; per-LOB impacts are therefore not provided (null) except Professional Lines which is related to the LPR (inferred). All monetary amounts are presented in the native currency (USD) and converted to millions (numbers in this JSON are in millions).
